秦宇甩开手背上的残茶，勃然大怒，指着林川的鼻子就要发作。

林川靠在太师椅背上，连头都没抬，手指敲击着桌面，发出有节奏的哒哒声。

“华尔街学回来的几个破词儿，就敢拿来国内套壳圈地？”林川声音不大，话却极重，

“第一，你们那个云创中心的底层架构，根本不支持高并发的B2B交易流。这种端口接给初创企业，三天就会全盘崩溃。”

“第二，缺乏应用场景的纯硬件堆砌，在市里的评估体系里就是骗补工程，查你都算轻的。”

“第三，你拿撤资威胁我？”

林川停下敲击桌面的手指，抬眼盯着秦宇。

“你不看九州创投的财报？我账上趴着几个亿的纯现金。顾氏那点配套资金撤走，我明天就能用两倍的钱补上窟窿。”

他身体微微前倾，极强的压迫感直逼过去。

“没有九州点头，张江没有一家企业会接入你们的端口。你们的数据中心，就是一堆放在浦东吃灰的废铁。”

秦宇脸上一阵青白交加。他引以为傲的海归精英身份，在这个比他年轻十岁的男人面前毫无还手之力，被几句话扒得底裤都不剩。

但他绝不甘心。

“林川，你太狂了！”秦宇掏出手机，

“张江不是你九州一家说了算！你在园区里弄了几栋楼，就想只手遮天？我这就给管委会的周处长打电话，顾家的面子，还轮不到你来踩！”

秦宇直接拨通了周处长的私人号码，特意按下了免提键。

他要在顾清烟面前，看着林川在官方权力面前低头认怂。

电话响了两声被接起。

“周处，我是顾氏的秦宇。张江那个云创数据中心的审批，不需要再绕弯子了，直接走市里的特批流程。至于九州创投那边的不配合，管委会是不是该出面敲打敲打？”

电话那头死一般寂静。

过了足足五秒，周处长极度冷淡、甚至带着十二分避之不及的声音传了出来。

“秦总，你搞错了一件事。”

周处长的声音在安静的包间里尤为清晰。

Qin Yu shook off the remaining tea on the back of his hand, became furious, and pointed at Lin Chuan's nose, about to explode.

Lin Chuan leaned on the back of the Taishi's chair, without even raising his head, tapping his fingers on the table, making a rhythmic clicking sound.

"You dare to use a few bad words you learned from Wall Street to frame the domestic market?" Lin Chuan's voice was not loud, but his words were very serious.

"First, the underlying architecture of your cloud innovation center does not support high-concurrency B2B transaction flows. If this kind of port is connected to start-ups, it will completely collapse in three days."

"Second, pure hardware without application scenarios is regarded as a fraudulent subsidy project in the city's evaluation system, and even if you are investigated, it will be considered an easy task."

"Third, are you threatening me with divestment?"

Lin Chuan stopped tapping his fingers on the table and raised his eyes to stare at Qin Yu.

"Don't you read the financial report of Jiuzhou Venture Capital? I have hundreds of millions of pure cash on my account. With Gu's supporting funds withdrawn, I can use twice the money to fill the hole tomorrow."

He leaned forward slightly, feeling a strong sense of oppression approaching.

"Without Jiuzhou's nod, no company in Zhangjiang will connect to your port. Your data center is just a pile of scrap metal sitting in Pudong to gather dust."

Qin Yu's face turned blue and white.He was proud of his elite status as a returnee from overseas, but he was helpless in front of this man who was ten years younger than him. He was stripped of his pants by a few words.

But he would never give in.

"Linchuan, you are too crazy!" Qin Yu took out his mobile phone and said,

"Zhangjiang, it's not your Jiuzhou family that has the final say! You have built a few buildings in the park and you want to cover the sky with one hand? I will call Director Zhou of the management committee right now. It's not your turn to trample on the Gu family's face!"

Qin Yu directly dialed Director Zhou's personal number and pressed the hands-free button specifically.

He wanted to watch Lin Chuan bow his head in front of official power in front of Gu Qingyan.

The phone rang twice and was picked up.

"Chu Zhou, I am Qin Yu from the Gu family. There is no need to go through any detours for the approval of the Yunchuang data center in Zhangjiang. We can go directly to the city's special approval process. As for Jiuzhou Venture Capital's lack of cooperation, should the management committee step in and crack down on it?"

There was deathly silence on the other end of the phone.

After five full seconds, Director Zhou's extremely cold and even avoidable voice came out.

"Mr. Qin, you made a mistake."

Director Zhou's voice was particularly clear in the quiet private room.
